title: Georgia county ad valorem millage rate record
description: One tax district in one county in one tax year, from the Georgia Department of Revenue's Tax Digest Consolidated Summaries. The key is (countyCode, districtCode, taxYear, occurrence).

countyCode.description: DOR county code, 1-159 alphabetically. Part of the key.

countyName.description: Canonical county name for that code. DOR abbreviates some names per row, giving 191 distinct names for 159 codes, so this is the modal name per code and NOT a join key.

countyNameAsFiled.description: The county name exactly as that year's workbook wrote it.

districtCode.description: Tax district code within the county. Part of the key. Only codes 0-3 mean the same thing statewide (countywide/state/school/county incorporated); above that they are per-county arbitrary.

districtName.description: District name as filed. DRIFTS BETWEEN YEARS for ~15% of districts, in both directions, with no consistent transform. Never join on it.

districtType.description: Derived classification: countywide, state, school, city_school, county_incorporated, county_unincorporated, county_service_district, city, fire, tad, cid, bid, ssd, hospital, library, recreation, development_authority.

occurrence.description: 1 for every row except where DOR lists the same county/district/year twice. Part of the key so repeated rows stay distinguishable; they are published unmerged.

millageMO.description: Maintenance-and-operations millage rate. null = none reported.

millageBond.description: Bond millage rate. null = none reported.

totalTaxMO.description: Total M&O tax levied, in dollars.

totalTaxBond.description: Total bond tax levied, in dollars.

assessedValueMO.description: Net M&O assessed value (40% of fair market value).

dataSource.description: Which DOR source the row came from: 'digest-xlsx' for the machine-readable Tax Digest Consolidated Summaries (2020 onward), or 'millage-pdf' for the 2019 millage-rate PDF. 2019 carries MILLAGE ONLY — its totalTax and assessedValue are null because the source has no such columns, NOT because a jurisdiction reported none. Filter on this before summing tax or assessed value by year.
